resources.string: Agreements, privacy information, and permission overview for Project Lumen in one place.

Confirming will turn off local usage statistics and stop all optional diagnostic uploads (crash reports, face-analysis samples, and installed-app inventory). Eye-break reminders and Pomodoro focus sessions remain fully usable.

Confirming stops the same data processing as the general consent withdrawal and additionally resets your privacy policy agreement. Project Lumen will ask you to review and re-agree to the policy on the next launch.
Consent withdrawn. Statistics and diagnostic uploads are now off.
Privacy policy consent withdrawn. The policy will be shown again on next launch.
